map.成人维生素 C 推荐摄入量 100 mg/天（可耐受最高摄入量 2000 mg）: Recommended vitamin C intake for adults is 100 mg/day (tolerable upper intake level 2000 mg), and zinc 7.5 to 12.5 mg/day (upper limit 40 mg); vitamin C is rich in fresh jujubes, kiwifruit and green peppers (30 to 240 mg per 100 g), and zinc is rich in oysters, lean meat and nuts (2 to 15 mg per 100 g); during an infection you can supplement in moderate amounts under medical guidance, but large doses should not be taken long term.

map.成人维 C RNI 100mg/天、UL 2000mg；锌男 12.5mg、女: For adults vitamin C RNI is 100mg/day with UL 2000mg; zinc is 12.5mg for men and 7.5mg for women with UL 40mg. One kiwifruit (about 70mg of vitamin C) plus one serving of oysters (16mg of zinc) easily hits the targets and can even exceed the zinc upper limit.
map.维 C：鲜枣、猕猴桃、柑橘、青椒；锌：牡蛎、红肉、坚果、全谷；均衡饮食通常不需补: Vitamin C: fresh jujubes, kiwifruit, citrus, green peppers; zinc: oysters, red meat, nuts, whole grains; a balanced diet usually needs no supplements.
map.维 C 越多越防感冒？: Does more vitamin C prevent colds?
map.常规剂量不能防感冒，仅略缩短病程；长期超 2000mg/天 易腹泻结石，不必狂补: Regular doses do not prevent colds and only slightly shorten the course; staying above 2000mg/day long term risks diarrhea and kidney stones, so megadosing is unnecessary.
map.锌过量有何害？: What are the harms of excess zinc?
map.长期超 UL(40mg) 干扰铜/铁吸收、抑免疫；补锌遵医嘱，食补更安全。: Staying above the UL(40mg) long term interferes with copper and iron absorption and can suppress immunity; follow medical advice for zinc supplements, and food sources are safer.
